verdict.rationale: Entra ID ships its own automation: Lifecycle Workflows run processes automatically against users as they move through joiner, mover and leaver phases. Conditional Access lets admins define if-then policy rules that apply actions such as requiring MFA when a user accesses an app. Both are scoped to identity events, and the evidence does not detail trigger configuration or custom actions. Missing for 10: documented trigger/event types and configuration, custom or extensible actions beyond identity lifecycle and sign-in policy, a general event-to-action rule engine, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Workflows contain specific processes that run automatically against users as they move through their lifecycle.
Lifecycle workflows (LCW) are identity governance capabilities that enable organizations to manage Microsoft Entra users across the three phases of a user's lifecycle with an organization
If a user wants to access an application or service like Microsoft 365, then they must perform multifactor authentication to gain access.
